verdict.rationale: GrowthBook has a first-party OpenFeature docs page saying that switching to or from GrowthBook only requires changing the provider bootstrap, not any flag calls. That directly addresses avoiding lock-in to its own SDK API. missing for 10: which languages or runtimes have OpenFeature providers, provider feature-parity details (e.g. experiments and tracking through OpenFeature), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can use the vendor through OpenFeature providers so my flag code isn't locked to one vendor's SDK API

citations.quote: Switching from or to GrowthBook only requires changing the provider bootstrap, not a single flag call.
